$comment: Source of truth for issue and PR labels. Sync with: node scripts/sync-labels.mjs [--apply] [--prune]. Every open issue carries one area:, one or more component:, one priority: and one kind: label. See CONTRIBUTING.md#issues and docs/scope.md. PR type labels are applied by .github/workflows/pr-title.yml and are not used on issues.

labels.name: area:opens-clean
labels.description: Word or LibreOffice opens the output with no repair prompt or error

labels.name: area:redline-correct
labels.description: Accept-all gives the target, reject-all gives the base; no phantom or missing changes

labels.name: area:preservation
labels.description: Untouched parts, rsids, fields, content controls and formatting survive

labels.name: area:legal-structure
labels.description: Numbering, defined terms, cross-references, footnotes, tables, headers and footers

labels.name: area:agent-contract
labels.description: MCP/CLI tool behaviour, warnings, error shape and schemas

labels.name: area:infra
labels.description: CI, release, coverage, test harness and corpus tooling

labels.name: priority:high
labels.description: Silently wrong or corrupt output that could reach a client

labels.name: priority:medium
labels.description: Fails loudly, or blocks a common legal-document workflow

labels.name: priority:low
labels.description: Rare, cosmetic, or a feature legal documents rarely use

labels.name: kind:investigation
labels.description: Time-boxed question; ends in concrete issues or a close

labels.name: kind:epic
labels.description: Task list of child issues only; no work happens on the epic itself

labels.name: internet-sourced
labels.description: Found by testing against a document from the public internet

labels.name: source:matter
labels.description: Found during real document work; reproduced with synthetic OOXML only

labels.name: loop-ready
labels.description: Minimal repro, named cause or search area, acceptance criteria; one session can fix it

labels.name: duplicate
labels.description: This issue or pull request already exists

labels.name: dependencies
labels.description: Pull requests that update a dependency file

labels.name: github_actions
labels.description: Pull requests that update GitHub Actions code

labels.name: javascript
labels.description: Pull requests that update javascript code

labels.name: llm-gate/override
labels.description: Maintainer override for the LLM quality gate
